caption: The drawing depicts a woodworking hand plane made primarily of wood with a metal blade. The body of the hand plane is a rectangular block of brown wood, showing visible grain, knots, and wear. Attached to the top is a smooth, curved wooden handle, also brown, with a contoured grip. The metal blade is partially embedded at an angle toward the front of the tool, extending upwards. Below and to the left of the main object is a simple black line drawing of the same shape as the plane's sole, showing an outline and a groove notched at the end. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are no other objects or significant markings besides faint text below the main drawing.
title: Rabbet Plane
